description: This PHP source file defines the RecruitmentPluginConfiguration class, which implements plugin configuration for the recruitment module in OrangeHRM. It registers services related to vacancies, recruitment attachments, and candidates into a service container during initialization.

classes.name: RecruitmentPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for setting up recruitment-related services in the plugin's configuration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering recruitment services into the service container.
